column7: Login/RefreshToken/VerifyMFA/BeginWebAuthnLogin/FinishWebAuthnLogin/FinishWebAuthnPasswordlessLogin all checked the per-IP login-attempt budget then ran the slow credential check (bcrypt/TOTP/WebAuthn assertion) and only recorded the attempt afterward, on failure only -- a concurrent burst from one IP all observed the same under-budget count at check time and blew through the budget before the counter caught up. Fixed by moving the record (renamed reserveLoginAttempt) to run before the slow step, right after the request is well-formed, at every affected call site; see docs/findings/2026-09-20-FINDING-login-lockout-mfa-recheck.md
